notes.title: Kickstarter Launched with stretch goals (voice acting? additional characters?👀)
notes.content: [p]We're super excited to drop the free demo of lovebyte.exe today! Along with the demo drop, we've also launched our Kickstarter campaign to help fund the project. The funds will be used to take the game from demo stage to the full version of the game. Additionally, we would love to be able to afford more game features so we have created stretch goals - including adding more characters, artwork, voice acting, and special content.[/p][p][/p][p]If you're interested in seeing a better version of lovebyte.exe or you'd like to support a small indie team of 3 women, please consider checking out our [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/nochistudios/vtuber-chat?ref=1cw8xd"]Kickstarter Campaign[/url] and pledging! In return for the pledge, there are some exclusive, limited time rewards & merch that we will not be re-running after the campaign is over.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/nochistudios/vtuber-chat?ref=1cw8xd" style="button"]Check it out![/url][/p][p][/p][p]We hope you enjoy the demo![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621653/3588241caa9192c55314ddd27caed7e1cfb69d81.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]
